title: Method-version file, library/methods/<version>.yaml (Probata proof of concept ticket 11, 2026-10-14 ET)
description: One reviewed file listing everything a candidate artifact's proofs use apart from the rewrite contract, the candidate artifact and the proof semantics (map 26 item 3, S8). Every proof record pins it by ID and file sha256. A draft may mark a section {not_yet_built: <sentence>} (swdb.method_version). Documented in docs/reference/format-v0.4-method-version.md. Updated 2026-10-14 ET (fix-21): status is a lifecycle (current = highest-sequence frozen; drafts only by name).

id.x-reason: a method-version ID is method.<file name>

sequence.description: Order of frozen method versions: the current one is the frozen file with the highest sequence (unique among frozen files). A draft is never current; its records keep counting while its sequence is higher than the current frozen one's (fix-21).

status.x-reason: status is draft or frozen (59 freezes one)
status.description: Lifecycle (fix-21, 2026-10-14 ET): a frozen version can be current; a draft is used only when named (swdb prove --method-version, a campaign file's method_version). The freeze is a new file.

evidence_kind.x-reason: evidence_kind is contract_fixture (a fixture method version, for tests) or execution (a real method version; ticket 21): proof records under a fixture method version stay contract_fixture evidence

lineup.description: Every tool, solver and front end the proofs use, each with one exact version and its flags (11 item 8).

x-required-reasons.version: each lineup entry states one exact version
x-required-reasons.flags: each lineup entry states its flags (an explicit empty list when none)

version.x-reason: a lineup version is one exact version (digits and dots: no range, wildcard or "latest")

flags.x-reason: flags is a list of text flags (empty when none)

civl.description: CIVL settings (15 item 9); its k is in budgets.

c_lowering.description: The C-lowering subset, its translators and its naming rules (16).

checks.description: The three checks of 13 (proof setup check, proof hint check, verdict reading), each with its version.

budgets.description: Per-candidate budgets (25 item 2): hint rounds, hint-loop wall time, bounded job time, counterexample repair rounds; WP time per solver (13 item 11); CIVL's k (15 item 9, S8).

civl_k.x-reason: CIVL's k is an integer of at least 2 (15 item 9)

logic_library.description: The shared logic library, the sum library included (24). fix-21 (2026-10-14 ET): `files` pins each shared logic file as {id, version, sha256} (ticket 26's pin form); `sha256` is then the digest of that list (swdb.artifacts.digest); `sum_library` pins logic.sum the same way.

models.description: The std::vector and std::pair models (S8; ticket 25 writes them).

rocq_development.description: The Rocq development (41-43): it holds the parallel composition theorem and the DX100 reduction lemma.

ghost_capacity_k.x-reason: ghost capacity K is a positive integer (16 item 10)

version.x-reason: a reference's version is one exact dotted version (a logic file's `// version:` line)

reference.x-reason: a reference is {id, sha256} with an optional version

budget.x-reason: a budget is a positive integer
